[![Launch in Binder](https://mybinder.org/badge_logo.svg)](https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/CaltechExperimentalGravity/system_ident/HEAD?urlpath=lab/tree/docs/examples/04-suspension-multidof.ipynb)  ·  run this page live (no install; the [in-browser demo](interactive.qmd) is instant)

A 3-DoF suspension (POS / PIT / YAW) identified the Pintelon–Schoukens way — the same
sequential, one-DoF-at-a-time campaign the CLI runs. Each degree of freedom gets the
full diagnostic set: excitation design, the measurement time series, a
magnitude/phase/coherence Bode stack, residuals, parameter recovery against the
Cramér–Rao bound, drive-safety margins, convergence, and the pass-by-pass view. The
combined convergence and recovered-vs-true panels are up top; the per-DoF detail is in the
tabs below.

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Setup — config, twin backend, priors, per-DoF campaigns"
import sys, pathlib
_p = pathlib.Path.cwd()
for _c in [_p, *_p.parents]:
    for _d in (_c, _c / "docs"):
        if (_d / "sysid_plots.py").exists() and str(_d) not in sys.path:
            sys.path.insert(0, str(_d))

import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import sysid_plots as sp
from sysid_campaign import run_siso_passes, param_sigmas, param_convergence_series

from system_ident.config import RunConfig
from system_ident.loop import SysIDLoop

cfg = {
    "run": {"name": "susp3dof", "excitation_mode": "sequential"},
    "channels": {
        "excitation": {"POS": "C1:EXC_POS", "PIT": "C1:EXC_PIT", "YAW": "C1:EXC_YAW"},
        "readback":   {"POS": "C1:RSP_POS", "PIT": "C1:RSP_PIT", "YAW": "C1:RSP_YAW"},
    },
    "measurement": {"fs": 32, "freq_min": 0.1, "freq_max": 5.0,
                    "segment_duration": 128.0, "n_segments": 4, "px_total": 1.0},  # T_fft>3/f_min
    "strategy": {"estimator": "gml", "input_designer": "pintelon_schoukens", "n_design_iter": 3},
    "twin": {"sensor_asd": 1e-3, "plant": {
        "POS": {"resonances": [[0.6, 20], [1.5, 30]], "gain": 300},
        "PIT": {"resonances": [[0.8, 15], [2.2, 25]], "gain": 120},
        "YAW": {"resonances": [[1.2, 18]],            "gain": 80}}},
    "priors": {
        "POS": {"resonances": [[0.55, 18], [1.6, 28]], "gain": 250},
        "PIT": {"resonances": [[0.75, 13], [2.3, 22]], "gain": 150},
        "YAW": {"resonances": [[1.1, 16]],             "gain": 100}},
    "safety": {"actuator_sat": 1000.0,
               "rms_ceiling": {"POS": 1000.0, "PIT": 1000.0, "YAW": 1000.0},
               "ramp_down_secs": 2.0},
    "stop_criteria": {"uncertainty_target": 0.05, "max_iter": 2},
}
DOFS = ["POS", "PIT", "YAW"]
COLORS = {"POS": sp.SKY, "PIT": sp.GOLD, "YAW": sp.GREEN}
ACT_LIMIT = cfg["safety"]["actuator_sat"]

rc = RunConfig(raw=cfg)
backend = rc.build_twin_backend(seed=0)
priors = rc.build_priors()

m = cfg["measurement"]
FS = float(m["fs"]); NPERSEG = int(m["segment_duration"] * FS); NPER = int(m["n_segments"])
f_all = np.fft.rfftfreq(NPERSEG, 1 / FS)
band = (f_all >= m["freq_min"]) & (f_all <= m["freq_max"]); freq = f_all[band]
DUR = NPERSEG * NPER / FS

# One sequential P&S campaign per DoF (drive that DoF, read it back).
H = {}
for d in DOFS:
    rb = cfg["channels"]["readback"][d]
    Pyy = SysIDLoop._noise_psd(backend.read([rb], DUR)[rb], FS, NPERSEG, band)
    H[d] = run_siso_passes(backend, cfg["channels"]["excitation"][d], rb, priors[d],
                           fs=FS, nperseg=NPERSEG, n_periods=NPER, band=band, freq=freq,
                           Pyy=Pyy, px_total=float(m["px_total"]), n_passes=3,
                           prior_uncertainty=0.5, seed=0)
trues = {d: backend.plant[d] for d in DOFS}
fits = {d: H[d][-1]["model"] for d in DOFS}
```

## Parameters recovered — all three DoFs

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Prior → fit → true for every mode"
rows = []
for d in DOFS:
    for i, ((f0p, qp), (f0t, qt), (f0f, qf)) in enumerate(
            zip(sp.modes(priors[d]), sp.modes(trues[d]), sp.modes(fits[d])), 1):
        rows.append([f"{d} · mode {i}", f"{f0p:.3f}/{qp:.0f}", f"{f0f:.3f}/{qf:.1f}",
                     f"{f0t:.3f}/{qt:.0f}"])
sp.param_table(["DoF · mode", "prior  f₀/Q", "fit  f₀/Q", "true  f₀/Q"], rows,
               caption="Recovered modes (Hz / Q)")
```

## Convergence — worst parameter per DoF (overview)

The worst $\sigma/\theta$ for each DoF (the stop criterion). Every individual parameter's
convergence is in the per-DoF tabs below.

```{python}
#| label: fig-mdof-convergence
#| fig-cap: "Worst fractional uncertainty σ/θ per pass, for each of POS, PIT, and YAW, against the 5 % stop target."
#| code-summary: "worst σ/θ vs pass, all DoFs"
sp.convergence([dict(name=d, x=[h["pass"] for h in H[d]], y=[h["frac"] for h in H[d]],
                     color=COLORS[d]) for d in DOFS], target=0.05,
               ylabel="worst σ/θ per DoF").show()
```

## Recovered vs true — all DoFs

```{python}
#| label: fig-mdof-overlay
#| fig-cap: "Recovered plant (dashed) against the true plant (solid) for all three DoFs, on shared log axes."
#| code-summary: "Magnitude overlay, recovered (dashed) vs true (solid)"
fig = go.Figure()
for d in DOFS:
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=freq, y=np.abs(trues[d].eval(freq)), mode="lines",
                  line=dict(color=COLORS[d], width=2.6), name=f"{d} — true"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=freq, y=np.abs(fits[d].eval(freq)), mode="lines",
                  line=dict(color=sp._fade(COLORS[d], 0.6), width=2.0, dash="dash"),
                  name=f"{d} — recovered"))
fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Frequency  [Hz]", type="log")
fig.update_yaxes(title_text="|G(f)|", type="log")
sp.style(fig, height=440, legend="v").show()
```

## Per-DoF detail

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Helper: the full standard set for one DoF"
def show_dof(d):
    hist = H[d]; true = trues[d]; prior = priors[d]; final = fits[d]
    mask = hist[-1]["mask"]
    ann = [(f0, f"f={f0:.2f} Hz, Q={q:.0f}") for f0, q in sp.modes(true)]

    # 1 — excitation design
    sp.excitation_design(freq, np.abs(true.eval(freq)), np.sqrt(hist[0]["Pxx"]),
        np.full_like(freq, 1.0 / (freq[-1] - freq[0])),
        prior_mag=np.abs(prior.eval(freq)), annotations=ann).show()
    # 2 — time series
    t = np.arange(int(60 * FS)) / FS
    sp.timeseries(t, [(f"drive ({d})", hist[0]["drive"], sp.SKY)],
        [(f"{d} motion", hist[0]["response"], sp.GOLD)],
        titles=[f"<b>Drive</b> — {d} actuator (Schroeder multisine)",
                f"<b>{d} motion</b> — response"]).show()
    # 3+4 — Bode (mag / phase / coherence)
    sp.bode(freq, [
        dict(name="true", H=true.eval(freq), color=sp.SKY, width=2.6),
        dict(name="measured (±σ)", H=hist[-1]["H_acc"], color=sp.GRAY, mode="markers",
             err=hist[-1]["err_acc"], mask=mask),
        dict(name="prior", H=prior.eval(freq), color=sp.RED, dash="dot"),
        dict(name="ML fit", H=final.eval(freq), color=sp.GOLD, dash="dash"),
    ], coh=hist[-1]["coh"], coh_mask=mask).show()
    # 5 — residuals
    resid = ((hist[-1]["H_acc"] - final.eval(freq)) / hist[-1]["err_acc"]).real
    sp.residuals(freq, resid, mask).show()
    # 6 — parameter recovery (every mode + gain)
    groups, tgt = [], []
    for i, ((f0p, qp), (f0t, qt), (f0f, qf)) in enumerate(
            zip(sp.modes(prior), sp.modes(true), sp.modes(final))):
        tgt += [f"f0_{i}", f"Q_{i}"]
    sig = param_sigmas(final, hist[-1]["cov"], targets=tuple(tgt) + ("gain",))
    for i, ((f0p, qp), (f0t, qt), (f0f, qf)) in enumerate(
            zip(sp.modes(prior), sp.modes(true), sp.modes(final)), 0):
        groups.append(dict(label=f"f{i+1} [Hz]", prior=f0p, fit=f0f, true=f0t, sigma=sig[f"f0_{i}"]))
        groups.append(dict(label=f"Q{i+1}", prior=qp, fit=qf, true=qt, sigma=sig[f"Q_{i}"]))
    groups.append(dict(label="DC gain", prior=sp.dc_gain(prior), fit=sp.dc_gain(final),
                       true=sp.dc_gain(true), sigma=sig["gain"], log=True))
    sp.parameter_recovery(groups).show()
    # 7 — saturation
    sp.saturation([{"pass": h["pass"], "peak": h["peak"], "rms": h["rms"]} for h in hist],
                  limit=ACT_LIMIT, rms_ceiling=cfg["safety"]["rms_ceiling"][d]).show()
    # 8 — convergence (every parameter of this DoF)
    tgt, labs = [], []
    for i in range(len(sp.modes(true))):
        tgt += [f"f0_{i}", f"Q_{i}"]; labs += [f"f{i+1}", f"Q{i+1}"]
    tgt.append("gain"); labs.append("gain")
    sp.convergence(param_convergence_series(hist, tgt, labs), target=0.05).show()
    # 9 — pass overlay
    sp.pass_overlay(freq, [dict(meas_mag=np.abs(h["H"]),
        fit_mag=np.abs(h["model"].eval(freq)), mask=h["mask"]) for h in hist],
        np.abs(true.eval(freq))).show()
```

## POS

```{python}
#| label: fig-mdof-pos
#| fig-cap:
#|   - "POS: prior-robust optimal drive against a flat drive of equal total power, over the true plant and the prior."
#|   - "POS: first ~60 s of pass 1 — the Schroeder multisine at the actuator and the motion it produces."
#|   - "POS: magnitude, phase, and coherence after the final pass, with the measured points carrying their per-bin ±σ."
#|   - "POS: normalised fit residuals (measured − fit)/σ against frequency, with their histogram."
#|   - "POS: prior, ML fit, and true value for every mode and the gain, with the Cramér–Rao σ as the error bar."
#|   - "POS: drive peak and RMS per pass against the actuator limit and the RMS ceiling."
#|   - "POS: fractional parameter uncertainty σᵢ/θᵢ per pass, against the 5 % stop target."
#|   - "POS: measured FRF and ML fit at each pass, overlaid on the true plant."
#| code-summary: "POS — full diagnostic set"
show_dof("POS")
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Sequential excitation
`excitation_mode: sequential` drives one DoF at a time, keeping each response measurement
unambiguous — exactly the per-DoF campaigns shown in the tabs. A `simultaneous` mode would
require coherence-based channel separation.
:::

damping loop closed, where the reference-based FRF cancels the controller.
